children: Commodity trading advisors dumped nearly $3B of Nasdaq 100
futures across the past three trading sessions, marking their heaviest three-day selling wave since March 2025, according to data from Goldman Sachs.
The three-day net shift in CTA positioning plunged to -$2.72B—an extreme move against a historical average of -$0.01B.

The rules-based liquidation by systematic funds came during a market dip, pointing to potential algorithmic capitulation directly into a local market trough around 29K. Futures have since rebounded to 29.7K at the time of writing Wednesday but remain down some 2.1% from a month ago.

title: Nasdaq futures hit by heaviest CTA selling in over a year
